text: ハイテクな　ビルの　なかでの　いどう　しゅだんだぜ

structure.jp: ハイテクな　ビルの　なかでの
いどう　しゅだんだぜ
structure.en: it's the way to get around

patterns.name: 〜での
patterns.explanation: で says where something happens, and の ties that place to the thing named next. なかでの　いどう = 'getting around inside'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. しゅだんだぜ = 'it's the way, I tell ya'.
